prompt.en: At exactly noon on the same winter day in January, a student in Kanyakumari and a student in Delhi each measure the shadow of a 1-metre stick. Predict: will the shadows be the same length? What could they learn by sharing their results?
prompt.hi: January ke ek hi sardi ke din theek dopahar 12 baje, Kanyakumari ka ek student aur Delhi ka ek student 1 metre lambi chhadi ki parchhai naapte hain. Guess karo: kya dono parchhaiyan barabar hongi? Results share karke wo kya seekh sakte hain?

challenges.hint: Point to Delhi being much farther north than Kanyakumari

prompt.en: A labelled antacid liquid is described as bitter and soapy. Without tasting or touching it, would you expect it to be acidic or basic?
prompt.hi: Ek labelled antacid liquid ko bitter aur soapy bataya gaya hai. Bina taste ya touch kiye, tum ise acidic kahoge ya basic?

challenges.hint: Which clue matters more here: bitter and soapy, or sour?

prompt.en: An ant bite stings because the ant injects formic acid. Predict whether rubbing on (a) lemon juice or (b) a paste of baking soda would give relief, and why.
prompt.hi: Cheenti ke kaatne pe jalan isliye hoti hai kyonki cheenti formic acid daalti hai. Guess karo, (a) nimbu ka ras ya (b) baking soda ka paste lagaane se aaraam milega, aur kyon?

challenges.hint: Ask whether formic acid needs more acid or a base

options.text: (b) a paste of baking soda would give relief, and why

challenges.keyText: (b) a paste of baking soda would give relief, and why

prompt.en: In a school lab, Meera carefully adds a base to vinegar. The mixture becomes slightly warm. Which reaction explains this: neutralisation or evaporation?
prompt.hi: School lab mein Meera vinegar mein dhyan se ek base milati hai. Mixture thoda garam ho jata hai. Iski wajah kaunsi reaction hai: neutralisation ya evaporation?

challenges.hint: Think about what can happen when an acid reacts with a base.

prompt.en: Two acidic samples start at the same strength. Riya adds water to A; Arjun adds a base to B. Both colours become less strongly acidic on universal indicator. Which sample could become neutral through a reaction: A or B?
prompt.hi: Do acidic samples shuru mein ek jaise hain. Riya A mein paani milati hai; Arjun B mein base milata hai. Universal indicator par dono kam acidic dikhte hain. Reaction se kaunsa sample neutral ho sakta hai: A ya B?

challenges.hint: Water spreads an acid out; a base can cancel its effect.

prompt.en: Predict before you try: a wire joins the cell's + terminal to the bulb's base tip, but the cell's − terminal is not joined to anything. Will the bulb glow?
prompt.hi: Try karne se pehle guess karo: ek taar cell ke + terminal ko bulb ke neeche ke tip se jodta hai, par cell ka − terminal kisi se nahi juda. Kya bulb jalega?

challenges.hint: Point to where the current could go after the bulb

prompt.en: Two identical bulbs are joined one after the other in a single loop with a cell. Predict: will the second bulb, the one the current reaches 'later', be dimmer than the first?
prompt.hi: Do bilkul ek jaise bulb ek hi loop mein ek ke baad ek cell ke saath jode gaye. Guess karo: kya doosra bulb, jahaan current 'baad mein' pahunchta hai, pehle se kam jalega?

challenges.hint: Point to the single loop with nowhere for current to leak out

prompt.en: A torch needs two cells. Predict: will it light if one cell is put in the wrong way round, so that both + ends face each other?
prompt.hi: Ek torch mein do cell lagte hain. Guess karo: agar ek cell ulta lag jaaye, yaani dono + sire aamne-saamne hon, toh kya torch jalegi?

challenges.hint: Point to the two + ends touching

prompt.en: For a school-project lamp, Asha joins two cells and needs a safe power source. Which plan is correct: positive-to-negative with cells only, positive-to-positive with cells only, or positive-to-negative using a wall socket?
prompt.hi: School-project lamp ke liye Asha do cells jod rahi hai aur safe power source chahiye. Kaunsa plan sahi hai: positive-to-negative aur sirf cells, positive-to-positive aur sirf cells, ya positive-to-negative aur wall socket?

challenges.hint: Then consider which power source is safe for classroom experiments.

prompt.en: A circuit has a cell, a bulb and a switch that is OFF. Predict: if we take the switch out completely and join the two wires directly, will the bulb glow?
prompt.hi: Ek circuit mein cell, bulb aur OFF switch hai. Guess karo: agar switch poora nikaal ke dono taar seedhe jod dein, toh kya bulb jalega?

challenges.hint: Point to the cell as the source

prompt.en: Predict: in a single loop, if the switch is moved from before the bulb to after the bulb, will it still turn the bulb on and off?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: ek single loop mein agar switch ko bulb se pehle wali jagah se hata ke bulb ke baad laga dein, toh kya wo phir bhi bulb ko on-off karega?

challenges.hint: Point to the loop having only one path

prompt.en: Two identical bulbs are tested separately. Circuit A has one cell; circuit B has two identical cells connected correctly in a battery. Both switches are closed. Which bulb is likely brighter: A or B?
prompt.hi: Do ek jaise bulbs alag-alag test kiye gaye. Circuit A mein ek cell hai; circuit B mein do ek jaise cells sahi tarah battery mein jude hain. Dono switches band hain. Kaunsa bulb zyada bright hoga: A ya B?

challenges.hint: Compare what one cell and two correctly connected cells provide.

prompt.en: Predict: if you touch the tester's two wire ends to the two ends of a lead from a mechanical pencil, will the bulb glow?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: agar tester ke dono taar ke sire mechanical pencil ki lead ke dono siron se chhuaao, toh kya bulb jalega?

challenges.hint: Point to graphite being a special non-metal

prompt.en: In a cell-and-bulb tester, an aluminium snack wrapper makes the bulb glow. The same wrapper, folded so only its plastic-coated side touches both wire ends, does not. Which layer conducts: aluminium or plastic coating?
prompt.hi: Cell-aur-bulb tester mein aluminium snack wrapper se bulb jalta hai. Wrapper fold karne par sirf plastic-coated side dono wire ends ko chhooti hai, aur bulb nahi jalta. Kaunsi layer conduct karti hai: aluminium ya plastic coating?

challenges.hint: Compare the layer touching the wires in each test.

prompt.en: You must choose a material for the bells on a dancer's ghungroo. Would you pick plastic or brass? Explain using properties.
prompt.hi: Tumhe ek dancer ke ghungroo ki ghantiyon ke liye material chunna hai. Plastic chunoge ya peetal? Properties use karke samjhao.

challenges.hint: Point to temple bells made of metal

prompt.en: A dry piece of charcoal snaps rather than flattening when pressed. Which property does this show: brittleness or ductility?
prompt.hi: Sookhe charcoal ka tukda dabane par chapta hone ke bajay toot jaata hai. Yeh kaunsi property dikhata hai: brittleness ya ductility?

challenges.hint: Choose the property that describes breaking under pressure.

prompt.en: Two identical iron clips sit in open jars. One jar is dry; the other contains water that touches its clip. Which clip is more likely to rust: the dry-jar clip or the water-jar clip?
prompt.hi: Do ek jaise iron clips khule jars mein hain. Ek jar sookha hai; doosre mein paani clip ko chhoo raha hai. Kis clip par jung lagne ki sambhavna zyada hai: sookhe jar wali ya paani wale jar wali?

challenges.hint: Both jars are open, but only one clip gets moisture.

prompt.en: Three iron pins are left for a week: A in dry air, B under boiled water covered with oil, C in ordinary water in an open cup. Which pin should rust most: A, B or C?
prompt.hi: Teen iron pins ek hafte ke liye rakhi hain: A sookhi hawa mein, B ubale paani ke andar tel ki parat ke neeche, C khule cup ke aam paani mein. Sabse zyada jung kis par lagegi: A, B ya C?

challenges.hint: Dry air lacks moisture; boiled water under oil limits oxygen.

prompt.en: A school’s iron cycle stand has many scratches, and staff want long-lasting rust protection without repeatedly painting it. Which is better: galvanising it with zinc or washing it daily with water?
prompt.hi: School ke iron cycle stand par kai scratches hain. Staff baar-baar paint kiye bina lambe samay tak jung se bachana chahte hain. Kya behtar hai: zinc se galvanise karna ya roz paani se dhona?

challenges.hint: Daily washing can leave moisture on scratches.

prompt.en: A copper trophy, silver medal and gold medal are displayed in a humid school corridor. After years, which one is most likely to develop a green coating: copper, silver or gold?
prompt.hi: Ek copper trophy, silver medal aur gold medal school ke nami wale corridor mein rakhe hain. Kuch saalon baad kis par hari parat banne ki sambhavna sabse zyada hai: copper, silver ya gold?

challenges.hint: Recall which metal develops a green surface over time.

prompt.en: A class discusses the non-metals in food that help build our bodies. Which is one of them: carbon or helium?
prompt.hi: Class mein food ke un non-metals ki baat ho rahi hai jo hamari body banane mein madad karte hain. Carbon ya helium—kaunsa ek hai?

challenges.hint: Think about what living bodies are built from.

prompt.en: A lab stores sulphur powder and chlorine in separate sealed containers at room temperature. Which one is a gas: sulphur or chlorine?
prompt.hi: Lab mein room temperature par sulphur powder aur chlorine alag sealed containers mein rakhe hain. Inmein gas kaunsi hai—sulphur ya chlorine?

challenges.hint: A powder consists of tiny solid pieces.

prompt.en: A company fills sealed packets of roasted peanuts with a non-metal gas to slow the food’s spoilage. Should it use nitrogen or oxygen?
prompt.hi: Ek company roasted peanuts ke sealed packets mein non-metal gas bharti hai taaki food jaldi kharab na ho. Nitrogen ya oxygen—kaunsi use kare?

challenges.hint: Keeping oxygen away helps slow spoilage.

prompt.en: Think-only question. In a science video, a paper cup full of water is held over a steady flame. Predict: will the paper cup catch fire before the water boils?
prompt.hi: Sirf sochne wala sawaal. Ek science video mein paani se bhara kaagaz ka cup ek sthir lau ke upar pakda jaata hai. Guess karo: kya paani ubalne se pehle kaagaz ka cup jal jaayega?

challenges.hint: Point to the water soaking up the heat

prompt.en: In a school science demonstration, a teacher covers a small flame with a glass jar. Which requirement for burning is cut off: fuel, oxygen, or ignition temperature?
prompt.hi: School science demonstration mein teacher ek chhoti flame ko glass jar se dhak dete hain. Jalne ki kaunsi zaroorat cut off hoti hai: fuel, oxygen, ya ignition temperature?

challenges.hint: The cover separates the flame from fresh air.

prompt.en: A stone step at a Jaipur fort gets hot by day and cool at night. Its surface slowly cracks, but the pieces stay beside the step. Is this weathering or erosion?
prompt.hi: Jaipur ke ek fort ki patthar ki seedhi din mein garam aur raat ko thandi hoti hai. Uski satah dheere-dheere chatakti hai, par tukde wahin rehte hain. Yeh weathering hai ya erosion?

challenges.hint: Think about whether breaking and carrying away are different processes.

prompt.en: After a storm, wind carries loose sand from a school playground onto the road. Is the sand being weathered or eroded?
prompt.hi: Toofaan ke baad hawa school playground ki dheeli ret sadak tak le jaati hai. Kya ret ki weathering ho rahi hai ya erosion?

challenges.hint: Focus on the movement of loose material.

prompt.en: On screen is a height chart of five friends from age 9 to 16, with the later years hidden. Before you see them, predict: will all five have their biggest growth jump in the same year?
prompt.hi: Screen pe paanch doston ka 9 se 16 saal tak ka height chart hai, aage ke saal chhupe hue hain. Dekhne se pehle guess karo: kya paanchon ki sabse badi lambai ki chhalaang ek hi saal mein hogi?

challenges.hint: Point to friends of the same age looking different heights

prompt.en: Your height mark on the wall was 135 cm at age 10 and 137 cm at 11. Predict: will you keep growing only 2 cm a year until you are 18?
prompt.hi: Deewar pe tumhari lambai ka nishaan 10 saal pe 135 cm aur 11 saal pe 137 cm tha. Guess karo: kya tum 18 saal tak har saal sirf 2 cm hi badhoge?

challenges.hint: Point to a steep part on a growth chart

prompt.en: Two cousins, Priya and Arjun, are both 12. At a family wedding, Priya is taller than Arjun this year, though last year Arjun was taller. Is this normal? Why?
prompt.hi: Do cousins, Priya aur Arjun, dono 12 saal ke hain. Ek shaadi mein Priya is saal Arjun se lambi hai, jabki pichhle saal Arjun lamba tha. Kya ye normal hai? Kyon?

challenges.hint: Point to boys catching up later

prompt.en: After football practice, Kabir notices he sweats more than he used to. During adolescence, which become more active: sweat glands or bones?
prompt.hi: Football practice ke baad Kabir notice karta hai ki ab use pehle se zyada paseena aata hai. Adolescence mein kya zyada active hota hai—sweat glands ya bones?

challenges.hint: During adolescence, some skin glands become more active.

prompt.en: A health poster says, ‘Puberty and adolescence mean exactly the same thing.’ Which is more accurate: ‘Puberty is the physical-change process within adolescence’ or ‘Puberty begins only after adolescence ends’?
prompt.hi: Ek health poster kehta hai, ‘Puberty aur adolescence bilkul ek hi cheez hain.’ Kaunsi baat zyada sahi hai: ‘Puberty, adolescence ke dauraan hone wale physical changes ki process hai’ ya ‘Puberty adolescence khatam hone ke baad shuru hoti hai’?

challenges.hint: The other term focuses on bodily changes during that stage.

options.text: Puberty is the physical-change process within adolescence
Puberty begins only after adolescence ends

challenges.keyText: Puberty is the physical-change process within adolescence

prompt.en: A student notices an oily forehead and more pimples, though their diet has not changed. Which physical change of adolescence best explains this: more active oil glands or a growth spurt?
prompt.hi: Ek student ka forehead zyada oily ho gaya hai aur pimples bhi badhe hain, lekin diet nahi badli. Adolescence ka kaunsa change ise behtar samjhata hai—oil glands ka zyada active hona ya growth spurt?

challenges.hint: Think about what produces oil on the skin.

prompt.en: A metal lunchbox is warm after sitting in the sun. Riya places a cool metal key against it. Which way does heat pass between them: lunchbox to key or key to lunchbox?
prompt.hi: Dhoop mein rakha metal lunchbox garam hai. Riya usse ek thandi metal chaabi chhuati hai. Heat kis taraf jaayegi: lunchbox se chaabi ya chaabi se lunchbox?

challenges.hint: Conduction transfers heat between objects touching each other.

prompt.en: For a school experiment, you need heat to travel quickly through a strip. Which should you choose: aluminium or plastic?
prompt.hi: School experiment mein heat ko ek strip se jaldi guzarna hai. Kya chunoge: aluminium ya plastic?

challenges.hint: Think about how metals compare with plastic as heat conductors.

prompt.en: A science club needs a container that slows heat entering a cold drink. They can use a thin copper cup or a thick clay cup. Which material is the poorer conductor: copper or clay?
prompt.hi: Science club ko cold drink mein heat ka aana dheema karna hai. Thin copper cup aur thick clay cup milte hain. Poor conductor kaunsa material hai: copper ya clay?

challenges.hint: Compare a metal with a non-metal used for insulation.

prompt.en: A steel spoon rests in hot soup. Its handle warms, and soup near the bottom rises. Which involves a moving fluid: the handle warming or the soup rising?
prompt.hi: Garam soup mein steel ka chamach rakha hai. Uska handle garam hota hai aur neeche ka soup upar aata hai. Moving fluid kis mein hai: handle garam hone mein ya soup upar aane mein?

challenges.hint: Convection needs liquid or gas to move.

prompt.en: On a spacewalk, an astronaut's suit faces the Sun on one side. There is no air in space. Predict: will the side of the suit facing the Sun get hot?
prompt.hi: Spacewalk ke dauraan astronaut ke suit ka ek hissa Sun ki taraf hai. Space mein hawa nahi hai. Guess karo: kya suit ka Sun wala hissa garam hoga?

challenges.hint: Point to why spacesuits are white

prompt.en: A satellite's sun-facing panel warms up in space, where there is almost no air. Which transfers heat to it: conduction, convection, or radiation?
prompt.hi: Space mein satellite ka Sun ki taraf wala panel garam hota hai, jabki wahan lagbhag hawa nahi hai. Heat us tak conduction, convection ya radiation se pahunchti hai?

challenges.hint: Eliminate methods that need matter between the heat source and panel.

prompt.en: After rain, water vapour rises from a school garden’s leaves and later helps form clouds. Which process releases water vapour from the leaves: evaporation or transpiration?
prompt.hi: Baarish ke baad school garden ki pattiyon se water vapour upar jaata hai aur baad mein clouds banne mein madad karta hai. Pattiyon se vapour nikalne ka process evaporation hai ya transpiration?

challenges.hint: Plants release water vapour through their leaves.

prompt.en: Tie a key to a 50 cm thread, hang it from a table edge and time 10 swings. Now tie two keys together on the same length of thread. Predict: will the time for 10 swings be shorter, longer or about the same?
prompt.hi: Ek chaabi ko 50 cm ke dhaage se baandho, mez ke kinaare se latkaao aur 10 jhoolon ka samay naapo. Ab do chaabiyan saath baandh ke wahi lambaai ka dhaaga rakho. Guess karo: 10 jhoolon ka samay kam hoga, zyada hoga ya lagbhag utna hi?

challenges.hint: Ask for a guess and a reason first

prompt.en: Predict: if you start the pendulum with a small pull versus a slightly bigger pull (still a small swing), will the time period change much?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: agar pendulum ko thoda sa kheench ke chhodo ya thoda zyada kheench ke (par abhi bhi chhota jhoola), toh kya time period mein zyada farak aayega?

challenges.hint: Point to the bob speeding up on a bigger swing

prompt.en: Akash counted 'one' every time the bob reached the other side. He counted 20 in 15 seconds and wrote the time period as 0.75 s. What is the mistake?
prompt.hi: Akash har baar 'ek' ginta tha jab bob doosri taraf pahunchta tha. Usne 15 second mein 20 gine aur time period 0.75 s likha. Galti kya hai?

challenges.hint: Point to 'there and back' as one

prompt.en: During a lab activity, a pendulum takes 24 seconds to complete 12 oscillations. What is its time period?
prompt.hi: Lab activity mein ek pendulum 12 oscillations poore karne mein 24 seconds leta hai. Uska time period kya hai?

challenges.hint: Share the total time equally among all oscillations.

prompt.en: Meera counts 15 oscillations of a pendulum in 27 seconds. For a school demonstration, how long should she expect 5 oscillations to take at the same rate?
prompt.hi: Meera ek pendulum ke 15 oscillations 27 seconds mein ginti hai. Usi rate par school demonstration mein 5 oscillations ko kitna samay lagna chahiye?

challenges.hint: At the same rate, time changes in the same proportion.

prompt.en: A skating app shows Meera’s speed as 2 m/s. What distance does this speed say she covers in one second?
prompt.hi: Skating app Meera ki speed 2 m/s dikhata hai. Is speed ka matlab hai ki woh ek second mein kitni doori tay karti hai?

challenges.hint: In m/s, the unit after the slash is the time unit.

prompt.en: During a school sports event, a remote-controlled car travels 24 metres in 6 seconds. What is its average speed in m/s?
prompt.hi: School sports event mein ek remote-controlled car 6 seconds mein 24 metres chalti hai. Uski average speed m/s mein kitni hai?

challenges.hint: Divide the total distance by the total time.

prompt.en: In a cycling trial, Sana covers 900 m in 3 minutes. Dev covers 1,200 m in 5 minutes. Who is faster: Sana or Dev?
prompt.hi: Cycling trial mein Sana 3 minutes mein 900 m chalti hai. Dev 5 minutes mein 1,200 m chalta hai. Kaun tez hai: Sana ya Dev?

challenges.hint: Find the distance each cyclist covers per minute.

prompt.en: A train’s speed display reads 72 km/h. Using 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s, what is that speed in m/s?
prompt.hi: Train ki speed display par 72 km/h hai. Agar 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s, toh yeh speed m/s mein kitni hogi?

challenges.hint: Multiply the km/h reading by the stated factor.

prompt.en: A car's total distance from the start after each minute is 1 km, 2 km, 3 km and 4 km. Is its motion uniform? How do you know?
prompt.hi: Ek car ki shuruaat se kul doori har minute ke baad 1 km, 2 km, 3 km aur 4 km hai. Kya uski gati uniform hai? Kaise pata?

challenges.hint: Point to subtracting one reading from the next

prompt.en: A marble is rolled along a long, smooth floor and slowly comes to a stop. Before measuring, predict: will it cover the same distance in every second?
prompt.hi: Ek kanche ko lambe, chikne farsh pe ludhkaaya jaata hai aur wo dheere dheere ruk jaata hai. Naapne se pehle guess karo: kya wo har second barabar doori tay karega?

challenges.hint: Point to it slowing down

prompt.en: Imagine dropping a small ball and taking a photo every tenth of a second as it falls. Predict: will the gaps between the ball's positions be equal, growing or shrinking?
prompt.hi: Socho ek chhoti ball giraayi aur girte waqt har second ke dasve hisse mein uski photo li. Guess karo: ball ki jagahon ke beech ke gap barabar honge, badhte jaayenge ya ghatte jaayenge?

challenges.hint: Point to the ball speeding up as it falls

prompt.en: A skater covers 5 m in every second while circling a rink. Is this uniform linear motion? Answer yes or no, and give the key reason.
prompt.hi: Ek skater rink ka chakkar lagate hue har second 5 m chalta hai. Kya yeh uniform linear motion hai? Haan ya nahin bolo, aur mukhya wajah batao.

challenges.hint: Think about the shape of the path, not just the timing.

prompt.en: A delivery rider travels 6 km in the first 15 minutes and 2 km in the next 15 minutes. What is the average speed for the whole trip, in km/h?
prompt.hi: Ek delivery rider pehle 15 minute mein 6 km aur agle 15 minute mein 2 km chalta hai. Poori trip ki average speed km/h mein kitni hai?

challenges.hint: Average speed uses the whole trip, not just one interval.

prompt.en: After a bite of idli leaves the stomach, which part of the digestive tract does it enter next: the small intestine or the large intestine?
prompt.hi: Idli ka ek niwala stomach se nikalne ke baad digestive tract ke kis hisse mein jaata hai: small intestine ya large intestine?

challenges.hint: Think of the route food follows, not the sizes of the parts.

prompt.en: At a school picnic, Meera eats a banana. In which part is most digested food absorbed into her body: the stomach or the small intestine?
prompt.hi: School picnic mein Meera kela khaati hai. Digested food ka zyada hissa body mein kahaan absorb hota hai: stomach ya small intestine?

challenges.hint: Look for the part where digested food passes into the body.

prompt.en: During diarrhoea, waste moves through the large intestine too quickly. Why might the body lose more water: less water is absorbed, or less food is chewed?
prompt.hi: Diarrhoea mein waste large intestine se bahut jaldi guzarta hai. Body zyada paani kyun kho sakti hai: kam paani absorb hota hai, ya food kam chabaya jaata hai?

challenges.hint: Think about what changes when waste spends less time there.

prompt.en: A science poster swaps these labels: ‘bile from the pancreas’ and ‘digestive juice from the liver’. Which correction is right: bile comes from the liver, or bile comes from the stomach?
prompt.hi: Science poster par labels ulte lage hain: ‘bile from the pancreas’ aur ‘digestive juice from the liver’. Sahi correction kya hai: bile liver se aata hai, ya stomach se?

challenges.hint: The pancreas makes a different digestive juice.

prompt.en: A mosquito feeds on blood through a thin tube-like mouthpart. Does it take in food by biting and chewing, sucking, or swallowing whole?
prompt.hi: Machhar apne patle, nali jaise mouthpart se khoon leta hai. Woh khaana kaise leta hai: kaatkar chabaata hai, choosta hai, ya poora nigalta hai?

challenges.hint: Think about how liquid moves through a tube.

prompt.en: At a pond, a frog catches an insect with its tongue; a dragonfly breaks an insect into pieces with its jaws. Which one swallows its food whole: the frog or the dragonfly?
prompt.hi: Talaab par mendhak jeebh se keeda pakadta hai; dragonfly apne jabdon se keede ke tukde karti hai. Khaana poora kaun nigalta hai: mendhak ya dragonfly?

challenges.hint: Swallowing whole means not breaking the prey up first.

prompt.en: A microscope video shows an amoeba extending pseudopodia around a food particle. After the particle is enclosed, where is it digested: in a food vacuole or in the pseudopodia?
prompt.hi: Microscope video mein amoeba food particle ke ird-gird pseudopodia badhaata hai. Particle ghir jaane ke baad woh kahan digest hota hai: food vacuole mein ya pseudopodia mein?

challenges.hint: Look for the enclosed space formed after food enters.

prompt.en: A cricketer takes air into her lungs, then her leg cells use oxygen to release energy from food. Which action is respiration: air entering the lungs or energy being released in leg cells?
prompt.hi: Ek cricketer apne lungs mein hawa leti hai. Phir uske pair ki cells oxygen use karke food se energy nikaalti hain. Respiration kaunsi action hai: lungs mein hawa jaana ya leg cells mein energy release hona?

challenges.hint: Breathing moves air; respiration uses food inside cells.

options.text: energy being released in leg cells

challenges.keyText: energy being released in leg cells

prompt.en: Two sealed jars contain equal volumes of air: one was filled with fresh outdoor air, the other with air students breathed out. Which jar has more carbon dioxide: the outdoor-air jar or the breathed-out-air jar?
prompt.hi: Do sealed jars mein barabar hawa hai: ek mein fresh outdoor air, doosre mein students ki saans se nikli hawa. Kis jar mein carbon dioxide zyada hogi: outdoor-air jar ya breathed-out-air jar?

challenges.hint: Cells produce a gas that leaves when we exhale.

prompt.en: A famous experiment (van Helmont, about 400 years ago): a willow sapling of about 2.3 kg was grown in a tub of 90 kg of dried soil for five years, given only water. It grew to about 77 kg. Predict how much soil was lost: about 74 kg, about 7 kg, or only about 57 grams?
prompt.hi: Ek mashhoor experiment (van Helmont, lagbhag 400 saal pehle): lagbhag 2.3 kg ka willow ka paudha 90 kg sukhi mitti ke tub mein paanch saal tak ugaaya gaya, sirf paani diya gaya. Woh lagbhag 77 kg ka ho gaya. Guess karo kitni mitti kam hui: lagbhag 74 kg, 7 kg, ya sirf 57 gram?

challenges.hint: Point to how little the soil changed

prompt.en: A spinach plant grows new leaves in a sunny school garden. Where does it make the glucose used for growth: in its green leaves or in the soil?
prompt.hi: School garden mein palak ke paudhe par dhoop mein naye patte ugte hain. Growth ke liye glucose kahan banta hai: hare patton mein ya mitti mein?

challenges.hint: Think of the part where photosynthesis happens.

prompt.en: A science club grows mint in water under a lamp. The roots get water, and the green leaves get light. Which gas must the leaves take in to make food: carbon dioxide or oxygen?
prompt.hi: Science club lamp ke neeche paani mein pudina uga raha hai. Jad ko paani aur hare patton ko light milti hai. Food banane ke liye patte kaunsi gas lete hain: carbon dioxide ya oxygen?

challenges.hint: Think about the gas plants use alongside water.

prompt.en: A sealed classroom plant chamber has water, a bright lamp and green leaves, but its carbon dioxide is removed. Which addition would let the plant make glucose again: carbon dioxide or extra oxygen?
prompt.hi: Ek band classroom plant chamber mein paani, bright lamp aur hare patte hain, par carbon dioxide hata di gayi hai. Paudha phir se glucose bana sake, iske liye kya daaloge: carbon dioxide ya extra oxygen?

challenges.hint: Light and water are present; check the gas supply.

prompt.en: A basil plant is kept by a window all day, then in a dark room overnight. At midnight, which processes are happening in its leaves: respiration only, photosynthesis only, or both?
prompt.hi: Tulsi ka paudha poora din khidki ke paas tha, phir raat bhar andhere kamre mein rakha gaya. Aadhi raat ko uske patton mein kya chal raha hoga: sirf respiration, sirf photosynthesis, ya dono?

challenges.hint: One process needs light; the other continues at night.

prompt.en: A coriander plant on a balcony is making food in bright sunlight. Which gas must enter its leaves through stomata for this process: oxygen or carbon dioxide?
prompt.hi: Balcony mein coriander ka paudha tez dhoop mein food bana raha hai. Is process ke liye stomata se patton mein kaunsi gas enter karegi: oxygen ya carbon dioxide?

challenges.hint: Think of the gas that process uses as a raw material.

prompt.en: A school covers the leaves of one plant with a thin waterproof coating that blocks its stomata. Both plants get equal water. Which plant will lose less water vapour through its leaves: coated or uncoated?
prompt.hi: School ek paudhe ke patton par patli waterproof coating lagata hai jo stomata block karti hai. Dono paudhon ko barabar paani milta hai. Patton se kam water vapour kaunsa paudha khoyega: coated ya uncoated?

challenges.hint: Blocking those openings changes the route for water loss.

prompt.en: A school gardener adds dissolved mineral fertiliser to the soil around a tomato plant. Which tissue carries the absorbed minerals from the roots up the stem: xylem or phloem?
prompt.hi: School gardener tomato plant ke aas-paas ki mitti mein ghula hua mineral fertiliser daalta hai. Roots se absorb hue minerals ko stem mein upar kaunsa tissue le jaata hai: xylem ya phloem?

challenges.hint: Think of the tissue that carries water with dissolved minerals.

prompt.en: A mango tree makes food in its leaves. Which tissue carries some of that food to a growing mango: xylem or phloem?
prompt.hi: Mango tree apni leaves mein food banata hai. Us food ka kuch hissa badhte hue aam tak kaunsa tissue le jaata hai: xylem ya phloem?

challenges.hint: Food and water travel in different tissues.

prompt.en: A bean plant absorbs water containing dissolved minerals. A narrow ring of phloem is removed from its stem, but the xylem remains intact. Can the minerals still reach its upper leaves: yes or no?
prompt.hi: Bean plant dissolved minerals wala paani absorb karta hai. Uske stem se phloem ki ek patli ring hata di jaati hai, par xylem salamat rehta hai. Kya minerals ab bhi upar ki leaves tak pahunch sakte hain: haan ya nahin?

challenges.hint: Trace the route taken by water and dissolved minerals.

prompt.en: A plant’s leaves make sugar, while its underground roots cannot make their own food. To deliver sugar from leaves to roots, should the plant use xylem or phloem?
prompt.hi: Plant ki leaves sugar banati hain, lekin zameen ke neeche ki roots apna food nahin bana sakti. Leaves se roots tak sugar pahunchane ke liye plant xylem use karega ya phloem?

challenges.hint: Choose the tissue that transports food, not absorbed water.

prompt.en: Two identical potted plants have equally moist soil. One is under a fan; the other is in still air. If moving air increases transpiration, which plant will have a stronger upward pull of water: the fan plant or the still-air plant?
prompt.hi: Do ek jaise potted plants ki mitti barabar geeli hai. Ek fan ke neeche hai, doosra shaant hawa mein. Agar chalti hawa transpiration badhati hai, to paani ka upward pull kismein zyada hoga: fan wala ya shaant hawa wala plant?

challenges.hint: Greater transpiration creates a stronger upward pull.

prompt.en: At a school event, a glow stick shines after it is bent. Is the glowing stick luminous or non-luminous?
prompt.hi: School event mein glow stick modne ke baad chamakti hai. Chamakte hue stick luminous hai ya non-luminous?

challenges.hint: Classify it by where the light comes from.

prompt.en: A folder cover lets you see a bright lamp through it, but not the lamp's clear outline. Is the cover transparent, translucent or opaque?
prompt.hi: Ek folder cover ke paar bright lamp dikhta hai, lekin lamp ki outline saaf nahi dikhti. Cover transparent, translucent ya opaque hai?

challenges.hint: Also check whether you can see a clear outline.

prompt.en: A cyclist sees a road stud shine only when her headlamp points at it. A nearby LED marker keeps shining when the headlamp is turned away. Which is luminous: the road stud or the LED marker?
prompt.hi: Cyclist ko road stud sirf headlamp ki roshni padne par chamakta dikhta hai. Paas ka LED marker headlamp hatane par bhi chamakta hai. Luminous kaun hai: road stud ya LED marker?

challenges.hint: Look for the object that gives out its own light.

prompt.en: From memory: can a transparent sheet of glass make a dark shadow? Why or why not?
prompt.hi: Yaad se batao: kya saaf kaanch ki sheet kaali parchhaai bana sakti hai? Kyun ya kyun nahi?

challenges.hint: What kind of object makes a dark shadow?

prompt.en: At a school exhibition, a cardboard cut-out is held between a fixed bulb and a fixed screen. If the cut-out moves closer to the bulb, does its shadow on the screen get bigger or smaller?
prompt.hi: School exhibition mein cardboard cut-out ek fixed bulb aur fixed screen ke beech hai. Cut-out ko bulb ke paas le jaane par screen par uski parchhaai badi hogi ya chhoti?

challenges.hint: The rays spread out as they travel towards the screen.

prompt.en: A rectangular tablet is held upright between a torch and a wall. First it faces the torch; then it is turned edge-on without changing its distance from the torch. Will its shadow on the wall become wider or narrower?
prompt.hi: Ek rectangular tablet torch aur deewar ke beech seedha pakda hai. Pehle uska saamna torch ki taraf hai; phir bina doori badle use kinare ki taraf ghumaate hain. Deewar par parchhaai chaudi hogi ya patli?

challenges.hint: Shadow shape depends on the object’s orientation to the light.

prompt.en: Sunlight falls on a glossy phone screen and a matte phone case. Which surface is more likely to show a clear reflection of a window: the screen or the case?
prompt.hi: Dhoop ek glossy phone screen aur matte phone case par padti hai. Khidki ka saaf reflection kismein dikhne ki zyada sambhavna hai: screen ya case?

challenges.hint: A smooth surface sends reflected light in an orderly way.

prompt.en: In a science demo, a laser ray strikes a plane mirror at 25° to its surface. What angle does the reflected ray make with the normal, the line perpendicular to the mirror?
prompt.hi: Science demo mein laser ray plane mirror ki surface se 25° ka angle banakar takrati hai. Reflected ray normal, yaani mirror par seedhi khadi line, se kitna angle banayegi?

challenges.hint: The surface and normal make a right angle; reflected and incident angles match.

prompt.en: At what angle are the two mirrors in a periscope placed, and are they parallel to each other?
prompt.hi: Periscope mein dono sheeshe kis kon pe lagte hain, aur kya ek doosre ke parallel hote hain?

challenges.hint: Half of 90 is?

prompt.en: From memory: how long does the Earth take to go once around the Sun?
prompt.hi: Yaad se batao: Earth ko Sooraj ka ek chakkar lagaane mein kitna samay lagta hai?

challenges.hint: And the leap year clue

prompt.en: Two students check sunrise from Kolkata and Jaipur on the same morning. Which city sees sunrise earlier: Kolkata or Jaipur?
prompt.hi: Do students ek hi subah Kolkata aur Jaipur se sunrise check karte hain. Sunrise pehle kahaan dikhega: Kolkata ya Jaipur?

challenges.hint: Earth's turning brings eastern places into sunlight first.

prompt.en: A planetarium model shows Earth on opposite sides of its orbit in June and December. One student keeps its tilted axis parallel in both positions; another turns the axis to face the Sun each time. Whose model is accurate: first or second?
prompt.hi: Planetarium model mein Earth June aur December mein orbit ki opposite sides par hai. Ek student axis ko dono jagah parallel rakhta hai; doosra har baar Sun ki taraf ghumata hai. Kiska model sahi hai: pehle ka ya doosre ka?

challenges.hint: Compare the axis directions in the two positions.

prompt.en: From memory: is it safe to watch a lunar eclipse with your naked eyes?
prompt.hi: Yaad se batao: kya chandra grahan nangi aankhon se dekhna surakshit hai?

challenges.hint: Is the Moon dangerously bright?

prompt.en: During a solar eclipse, a school in Jaipur sees the Sun partly covered, but a school in Kochi does not. Which school is in the Moon’s shadow: Jaipur or Kochi?
prompt.hi: Solar eclipse ke waqt Jaipur ke school ko Sooraj ka kuch hissa dhaka dikhta hai, lekin Kochi ke school ko nahi. Moon ki shadow mein kaunsa school hai: Jaipur ya Kochi?

challenges.hint: The covering is visible where the Moon blocks sunlight.

prompt.en: At a night-time skywatch, the Moon moves into Earth’s shadow. Which object is between the Sun and the Moon: Earth or Mars?
prompt.hi: Raat ke skywatch mein Moon, Earth ki shadow mein aa jaata hai. Sun aur Moon ke beech kaunsa object hai: Earth ya Mars?

challenges.hint: A shadow forms behind the object blocking sunlight.

prompt.en: During a solar eclipse, students in Surat see the Sun completely covered; students in Vadodara see only part covered. Which city lies in the Moon’s darkest shadow: Surat or Vadodara?
prompt.hi: Solar eclipse ke waqt Surat ke students ko Sooraj poora dhaka dikhta hai; Vadodara mein sirf kuch hissa dhakta hai. Moon ki sabse gehri shadow mein kaunsa shehar hai: Surat ya Vadodara?

challenges.hint: The darkest shadow blocks the whole visible Sun.
